notes: judge_transcripts.jsonl: response_*_tokens are token counts of the two candidate responses shown to the judge for that record. Every real matchup between two models is judged twice, once in each left/right order, sharing a swap_id. session_tag records which logging session produced the verdict; verdicts were collected in two session batches of very different size -- the larger batch is the evaluation team's deployed production judge, the smaller is an independent audit sample collected separately. A small fraction of records also have a malformed judge_verdict or a missing token count due to logging issues upstream; these should be excluded rather than fitted. human_calibration.jsonl: a smaller, independently collected set of human preference labels for the same matchups (fields model_a/model_b/human_verdict; win_a, win_b, or tie).
